transcription: Hand-transcribed by a model from 110 DPI renders; not human verified. Dashes written as ASCII hyphens; the underlined '<' glyph in the first row of Table 1M is written as U+2264 (the text layer extracts it as '<'). Digit groups use a space (e.g. '50 000') as printed, so they split into two numeric tokens under the whitespace rule. Table cells are joined by single spaces, one row per block; a table caption is its own block. 'Weighbeam of Beam Scale' in the Table 1/1M captions is the printed wording.
numeric_token_rule: whitespace-separated tokens containing a digit, leading/trailing . , ; : ( ) stripped (so '000' counts as a token)

blocks.text: S.1.5.2. Travel. - The weighbeam of a beam scale shall have equal travel above and below the horizontal. The total travel of the weighbeam of a beam scale in a trig loop or between other limiting stops near the weighbeam tip shall be not less than the minimum travel shown in Tables 1M and 1. When such limiting stops are not provided, the total travel at the weighbeam tip shall be not less than 8 % of the distance from the weighbeam fulcrum to the weighbeam tip.
Table 1M. Minimum Travel of Weighbeam of Beam Scale Between Limiting Stops
Table 1. Minimum Travel of Weighbeam of Beam Scale Between Limiting Stops
S.1.5.5. Capacity. - On an automatic-indicating scale having a nominal capacity of 15 kg (30 lb) or less and used for direct sales to retail customers:
T.N.3.2. Acceptance Tolerance Values. - The acceptance tolerance values shall be one-half the maintenance tolerance values.
